title: Copy-loop instruction
statement: For a natural number $E$, source and destination registers $s,d$ among $18$ registers, an exit label $e$, a function $m$ assigning a label to each of seven phases, and a phase $j\in\{0,1,\ldots,6\}$, define the instruction by these cases: at phase $0$, branch on whether $s=0$, going to $m(4)$ if so and to $m(1)$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $s$ and go to $m(2)$; at phase $2$, increment $d$ and go to $m(3)$; at phase $3$, increment a scratch register $z$ and go to $m(0)$; at phase $4$, branch on whether $z=0$, going to $e$ if so and to $m(5)$ otherwise; at phase $5$, decrement $z$ and go to $m(6)$; at phase $6$, increment $s$ and go to $m(4)$.
hypotheses_covered: Source and destination registers among 18 registers
